description: RankIt - Have the group rank {options} from most to least important

actions.action_goal: {"id": "rank_it_{topic_id}", "description": "Present options and have the group discuss and rank them together.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} presents the options: {options}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "{robot_name} asks the group to rank them by {ranking_criteria}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "At least one participant shares their ranking.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c4", "description": "{robot_name} keeps participants engaged for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "Stay neutral - don't judge opinions.", "React to what participants say and keep responses short."]}

options.description: The options to rank (e.g., 'honesty, humor, and loyalty')

discussion_time.description: How long to continue the discussion (e.g., '2 minutes', '90 seconds')
